title: View partial renders expensive helpers repeatedly
summary: Rails views call expensive helpers or render partials repeatedly across large collections.
rationale: Rendering overhead and allocation churn can dominate response time for collection-heavy pages.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Use collection rendering, precomputed view models, fragment caching, or simpler helpers.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
